title: Can the data tell you that?
instruction: You are looking at your channel’s statistics. Which conclusions really follow from the data, and which are only a correlation?
buckets: Only a correlation; we don’t know the cause

items.text: Most viewers came from the feed
Videos do better because it is Friday
items.why: Maybe you posted a better video on Friday.

items.text: The most watched video was the one about a cat
items.why: The number of views is measured.

items.text: I’m gaining followers because I changed my profile picture
items.why: It happened at the same time, but the cause could be anything else.

items.text: On my channel, people watch less of longer videos
items.why: The watch time is in the data for every video.

items.text: The hashtag #fyp made the video a success
items.why: Without comparing it with videos without the hashtag, you don’t know.

debrief: Data shows what happened and how much. Why it happened you often can’t read from it: two things go together, but the cause may lie elsewhere.
